value.rationale: The comparison fixes both the number and uniform marginals of random subspace Newton solves while altering only cross-step coupling, a natural practical design choice. Its complete planar analysis provides a nontrivial exact expected-error operator identity, strict universal improvement for every nonzero initial error and finite condition number, sharp contraction factors and the isotropic exact-termination boundary. Generic one-step convergence bounds cannot quantify this coupling effect.
